name: Veranda Resort Phuket, Autograph Collection
short_description: A design-forward Autograph Collection resort on Ao Yon Bay in the Cape Panwa area, roughly an hour from the airport on Phuket's quieter southeast coast.
ai_summary: Veranda Resort Phuket, Autograph Collection sits on Ao Yon Bay in the Cape Panwa area, an up-and-coming, comparatively trendy part of Phuket's southeast coast near Phuket Old Town, roughly an hour's drive from the airport. As an Autograph Collection property, it emphasizes distinctive, art-inspired design -- a 'Fluid Wonder' architectural concept, a Flower Sky Garden, and an Instagram-oriented layout -- across 159 rooms with ocean views, private pools, or family suites. It's rated 4 of 5 across more than 700 TripAdvisor reviews and ranks near the top of hotels in the Cape Panwa area, with guests consistently praising the clean, beautiful, and new-feeling design, a well-regarded breakfast, a stunning beachfront setting, and attentive service. Because the resort has only recently opened under this branding, its review base is smaller than the island's longer-established Bonvoy properties, so guest sentiment here, while positive, rests on a thinner track record. The main practical trade-off is location: Cape Panwa is quieter and more residential than Patong or the northern beaches, and the roughly 60-minute drive from the airport is one of the longer transfers among Phuket's Bonvoy portfolio.

faqs.question: Where is Veranda Resort Phuket, Autograph Collection located?
faqs.answer: It sits on Ao Yon Bay in the Cape Panwa area on Phuket's southeast coast, near Phuket Old Town and roughly an hour's drive from Phuket International Airport -- a quieter, more residential setting than the west-coast beach resorts.

faqs.question: Is Veranda Resort Phuket, Autograph Collection a new hotel?
faqs.answer: It has only recently opened under the Autograph Collection banner, so while early guest reviews are strongly positive on design, cleanliness, and breakfast, the review base is smaller than at longer-established Phuket Bonvoy resorts.
